title: Validation of the "sillage tourbillonnaire" test bench - a study on wingtip vórtices.
author: Samuel Araújo Lima
abstract: This work has the objective of validate a test bench designed to study wingtip vortices. The test bench is located in the SUPAERO (ÉCOLE NATIONALE SUPÉRIEURE DE L'AÉRONAUTIQUE ET DE L'ESPACE) facilities in Toulouse - France. The validation process consists in measure the lift of the wing and observe the flow after the passage of the wing through a test section, calculating several parameters, such as circulation, orthoradial velocities of the vortex and the vortex center motion. The data used to calculate these parameters are the local velocities of the test section, obtained through PIV (Particle Image Velocimetry), and post-processed through a computational routine. The parameters obtained experimentally are compared with the theory, in order to verify the quality of the results, and compared with each other, in order to verify the repeatability. With the post-processed results, it is possible to propose changes in the test bench, as well as experimental procedures for the use of the test bench that, if followed, will give experimental results that corresponds to the reality.
